comment: Independent dig.c rot_organic() container entry reached from do.c goto_level()'s run_timers(). Stash a dagger in a wished sack, drop and #wizbury it (bury_an_obj() schedules ROT_ORGANIC at 250 + rnd(250)), level-teleport away, wait past the maximum delay, and return. On arrival the rotting sack releases the dagger through bury_an_obj(), which draws obj_resists() and extracts it from the container.
